proposals.title: Add a drawdown guard
proposals.note: Pause trading after the account falls a set amount from its peak. Freqtrade has a max-drawdown and stop-loss guard, and Vibe Trading has an order guard with a halt switch.

proposals.title: Add a backup free data source
proposals.note: Prices and SEC filings are the only inputs today, so one outage stops the run. Vibe Trading has about 45 data loaders.

proposals.title: Write a quick-start in the README
proposals.note: Setup is the weakest area: a broker login, secrets and many workflows with no walkthrough. Freqtrade's docs are the model.

proposals.title: Add more automated tests
proposals.note: 152 tests today against Freqtrade's 1,619 and over 1,000 test files in Vibe Trading. Start with the order and risk code.

proposals.title: Backtest with costs and stops
proposals.note: Replay the strategies with fees, slippage and trailing stops at portfolio level, the way NautilusTrader and Jesse do.

proposals.title: Track more performance numbers
proposals.note: Add drawdown, profit factor and win rate to the daily scorecard next to the S&P comparison. Freqtrade and Jesse report these.

proposals.title: Stop depending on free Actions minutes
proposals.note: Schedules were paused when the 2,000 free minutes ran out. Run less often, or move the heavy jobs elsewhere.

proposals.title: Add significance tests for strategies
proposals.note: Jesse runs Monte Carlo and significance tests so a lucky backtest is not trusted.

proposals.title: Widen the indicator library
proposals.note: Ten strategies and a handful of indicators, against Jesse's 300+ and Freqtrade's TA-Lib.

proposals.title: Write richer reports
proposals.note: TradingAgents saves one readable HTML report per run with the reasoning behind each decision, and Vibe Trading sends PDF reports.
